tasks.title: Park Clean-Up Morning Planning
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Park clean-up morning
paragraphs: As you know, we are planning a park clean-up morning next month. I need your help to decide on a few things.
First, should we focus on collecting litter or on planting new flowers? Which do you think is more important for the park?
Also, we need to choose one practical thing to provide for volunteers. Would you prefer to give them free refreshments or free gloves?
Finally, can you suggest one way to encourage people to keep the park clean after the event?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which focus you prefer (litter or flowers) and explain why.
Choose one item to provide (refreshments or gloves) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to encourage long-term park care.
Ask Mrs Hill about the date of the clean-up.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Park Clean-Up Article
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town is organising a park clean-up morning next month.
Do you think this event will make a difference to the park?
What is the most important thing volunteers should do during the clean-up?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our town website!

tasks.title: Park Clean-Up Story
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator handed me the rubbish bags, I realised the park was much dirtier than I expected."
